services.subtitle: Custom intros, lower thirds and animated graphics that elevate your brand.
services.description: Custom intros, lower thirds and animated graphics that elevate your brand.
services.long_description:
Motion graphics should explain something in half a second. We design clean, on-brand animation that supports the edit instead of competing with it.
Delivered as ready-to-drop clips in your brand colours, type and pacing.
services.deliverables:
Rendered animation clips
Alpha-channel exports on request
services.bullet_points:
Custom vector animation
Logo reveals and transitions
Tracked callouts and stats
Brand-consistent styling

services.name: Thumbnail Design
services.subtitle: Scroll-stopping, high-CTR thumbnails that boost your click-through rate.
services.description: Scroll-stopping, high-CTR thumbnails that boost your click-through rate.
services.long_description:
A thumbnail is a tiny billboard. We design around one clear idea, keep contrast high and typography short so it still reads on a phone.
You get two variants per concept so you can test which one earns the click.
services.deliverables:
PNG + JPG at 1280×720
Editable source file
services.bullet_points:
Niche-based composition
Readable text hierarchy
Face cut-out and colour grading
Two variants per concept

services.name: Brand Videos
services.subtitle: Promotional and corporate videos that tell your brand story with impact.
services.description: Promotional and corporate videos that tell your brand story with impact.
services.long_description:
A brand film is the version of your story that people actually finish watching. We keep it short, specific and visually consistent with your identity.
The delivery includes the master film plus cutdowns sized for the platforms you actually post on.
services.bullet_points:
Narrative structure and voice-over bed
Brand colour and type treatment
Motion graphics package
Music licensing guidance

services.name: Social Media Ads
services.subtitle: High-converting ad creatives for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Reels.
services.description: High-converting ad creatives for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Reels.
services.long_description:
Paid social lives or dies on the first two seconds. We build each creative around one clear promise, then cut square, vertical and landscape versions so the same idea runs on every placement.
Every ad set ships with hook variants, so you can test what actually converts instead of guessing.
services.deliverables:
Master ad + placement exports
Hook variant cuts
services.bullet_points:
Hook variants for A/B testing
9:16, 1:1 and 16:9 versions
Burned-in captions
Safe-zone checked for each platform

services.name: Product Videos
services.subtitle: Clean, engaging product showcases that turn viewers into customers.
services.description: Clean, engaging product showcases that turn viewers into customers.
services.long_description:
A product video has one job: make the object feel worth owning. We build around clean product moments, add motion callouts for the details that matter and keep the pace short enough to finish.
Deliverables are sized for both your product page and paid placements.
services.deliverables:
Master product video (1080p / 4K)
Square and vertical cutdowns
services.bullet_points:
Product hero and detail passes
Motion callouts and labels
Clean background and grade
Cutdowns for ads and product pages

team_members.name: Rowshan Taieen
team_members.bio: বাংলাদেশের ইনফরমেটিক কন্টেন্ট এর পুরো প্যাটার্ন পাল্টে দিয়েছি আমি Voice of Dhaka এর হাত ধরে। সাথে বাংলাদেশের টপ সব চ্যানেলে এডিটিং করে যাচ্ছি আর নিজের হাতে তৈরি করা বড় ভিডিও ইন্টারন্যাশনাল মার্কেটপ্লেসে নিজেদের আলাদা জায়গা করে নিয়েছে।
team_members.description: রোশন তাইয়িন মেক্সা মোশনের প্রতিষ্ঠাতা ও লিড মেন্টর। ছয় বছরের বেশি সময় ধরে বাংলাদেশের টপ চ্যানেলগুলোর এডিটিং টিম পরিচালনা করেছেন, ভয়েস অফ ঢাকার হাত ধরে ইনফরমেটিক কন্টেন্টের প্যাটার্ন বদলে দেওয়ার কাজে যুক্ত ছিলেন। এডিটিং, স্টোরিটেলিং ও টিম লিডিং — তিনটাতেই তাঁর মূল দক্ষতা। স্টুডিওতে তিনিই প্রতিটি প্রজেক্টের ফাইনাল কোয়ালিটি রিভিউ করেন এবং নতুন মেম্বারদের মেন্টরিং করেন।

team_members.name: Arif Hossain
team_members.bio: Long-form edits with a story-first structure and a pacing pass on every cut.
team_members.description: Dhaka-based editor with seven years behind the timeline, most of them spent cutting long-form for YouTube creators and course sellers. Arif takes raw footage and builds a story with a clear opening, a pace that holds attention past the ten-minute mark and an ending that lands, then hands the cut to colour and sound with clean, labelled project files. His strengths are story structure, pacing and dialogue-driven editing in Premiere Pro. Inside the studio he leads the first cut on every long-form project and mentors the junior editors on retention-focused pacing.
team_members.skills:
Story structure
Pacing & rhythm
Premiere Pro
Audio cleanup
Caption styling
team_members.responsibilities:
Leads the first cut and story pass on long-form projects
Reviews editor drafts before they reach the client
Keeps project files and export naming consistent
Trains junior editors on retention-focused pacing

team_members.name: Nusrat Jahan
team_members.bio: Runs the weekly upload cycle — chapters, captions and on-time delivery.
team_members.description: Nusrat is the editor most clients talk to every week. She runs the upload cycle for creator channels — turning long interviews into watchable chapters, styling captions, cutting dead air and making sure each video is finished before the scheduled publish time without sanding off the creator's own tone. She works fast in Premiere Pro and is unusually good at reading a rough transcript to find the best twenty seconds. In the team she owns weekly delivery and coordinates the publish calendar with clients.
team_members.skills:
Interview editing
Caption styling
Chapter markers
Thumbnail stills
Workflow planning
team_members.responsibilities:
Cuts and delivers weekly channel uploads
Prepares chapter markers and caption files
Coordinates the publish schedule with clients
Flags footage gaps before the edit starts

team_members.name: Tanvir Ahmed
team_members.bio: Builds the animated layer of the brand — reveals, lower thirds, callouts.
team_members.description: Tanvir brings five years of After Effects work across brand films, ads and creator channels. He designs the animated layer of a video: logo reveals, lower thirds, stat callouts, transitions and the small motion details that make an edit feel expensive, all built around the client's type and colour system. His strengths are vector animation, kinetic type and clean transitions that never distract from the story. He owns the studio's motion template library, so every editor can drop in an intro that already looks on brand.
team_members.skills:
After Effects
Logo animation
Lower thirds
Vector illustration
Brand systems
team_members.responsibilities:
Designs intros, transitions and callout animations
Keeps motion assets on brand and reusable
Exports alpha-channel versions for editors
Maintains the shared motion template library

team_members.name: Sadia Islam
team_members.bio: One clear idea per thumbnail, two variants for testing.
team_members.description: Sadia designs the frame that decides whether a video gets watched at all. From a graphic design background with four years of YouTube thumbnails, she works one clear idea per image: high contrast, short readable type and a face expression that matches the promise of the title — always in two variants so clients can test the click. Her toolkit is Photoshop, composition and type hierarchy. She keeps every channel's thumbnails visually consistent and delivers platform-ready 1280×720 exports.

Photoshop
Composition

Face cut-outs
A/B variants
team_members.responsibilities:

Keeps a consistent look across a channel

team_members.name: Rakib Hasan
team_members.bio: The finishing pass — honest skin tones, clean dialogue, balanced music.
team_members.description: Rakib is the last person to touch a project before it ships. With six years of grading and mixing, he fixes skin tones, balances exposure between shots, cleans dialogue down to the room tone and sits the music under the voice so nothing fights. He grades in DaVinci Resolve, mixes to platform loudness standards and prepares the final export settings. In the studio he owns the finishing pass, so every delivery leaves with a consistent look and a mix that survives phone speakers.

team_members.responsibilities:

Prepares platform-ready export settings

team_members.name: Mim Akter
team_members.bio: Vertical hooks in the first two seconds, captions that stay readable.
team_members.description: Mim cuts the vertical side of the studio. She started as a creator editing her own Reels and now cuts Shorts, Reels and TikToks for brands and creators full time — hooks in the first two seconds, beat-matched cuts, captions that stay readable on a small screen and safe margins so nothing hides under the app UI. She is fast with vertical framing, hook variants and caption styling. She owns short-form delivery in the team and tests hooks before anything goes out.
